places.description: allowedModels + gateRegex enforced by the gate transition. Must hold exactly one token before arming.

description: Delegate token deletion in natural language. An agent reads the request and decides the strategy; a DETERMINISTIC pipeline then measures the place, executes, re-measures and composes the reply, so before/deleted/after are measured facts the model cannot author. Policy-gated: a target model outside the allowlist or a protected place is refused by a gate transition before anything is even read.

entry.howToUse: Write ONE token to p-janitor-task with flat string fields {requestId, request} and optionally {targetModel, place}. Then await a token in p-janitor-output whose requestId equals yours. The reply carries status (done|refused|nothing-to-do|unsupported|failed), strategy, before, deleted, after and a one-line message. Counts are measured by the pipeline.

place.description: Optional if the request text names it

request.description: Plain English, e.g. empty p-fj-shipped in academy

requestId.description: Your correlation id, echoed on the reply

targetModel.description: Optional if the request text names it

name: token-janitor

personas.description: Reads one request and writes one structured intent. It has rw only: it cannot preview, call HTTP, invoke tool nets or delete anything.
personas.name: janitor
